summary: Tested Email Module for league admins and team coaches. Backend: 16/16 tests passed - all endpoints working (GET /api/email/recipients, GET /api/email/history, GET/POST /api/teams/{team_id}/smtp-config, POST /api/email/compose). Frontend: Admin Portal Communications->Email tab shows EmailComposer with Compose/Sent/Settings views, recipient picker with team groups and checkboxes, templates fill subject/body. Team Admin Email section verified working (observed on Lions team page).
critical_code_review_comments: communication.py line 270-316: GET /api/email/recipients correctly filters by team_id and groups users by team
communication.py line 319-430: POST /api/email/compose validates inputs, gets SMTP config (team-level or league fallback), sends via SMTP with HTML styling, logs to email_history
communication.py line 186-249: Team SMTP endpoints work correctly for saving/retrieving team-specific email config
EmailComposer.js line 190-500: Well-structured component with compose/history/settings views, recipient picker, templates, proper data-testid attributes for testing
test_credentials: Admin user set via localStorage: mlbl_current_user with roles=['admin', 'coach']
seed_data_creation: POST /api/teams/eagles_01/smtp-config saved TEST_ prefixed SMTP config during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email module fully tested. Backend endpoints verified: GET /api/email/recipients (with optional team_id filter), GET /api/email/history (with team_id and limit), GET/POST /api/teams/{team_id}/smtp-config, POST /api/email/compose. Frontend: Admin Portal->Communications->Email tab renders EmailComposer. Team Admin->Email section renders EmailComposer with teamId prop. League SMTP configured with admin@mlbl.org. Team-level SMTP can be configured per-team. Email sending will fail in preview env due to invalid SMTP credentials - expected behavior.
